stage_cite: case-studies/trustedrouter-confidential-router/DEVPROOF-REPORT.md:8 **Verdict: ~Stage 1.** The chain is clean and the operator surface is small — routing is hardcoded, nothing is stored, the control plane is metadata-only. One residual (**G6**) lets the operator defeat the confidentiality claim in a way per-session verification cannot catch.

gaps.text: Shared ACME TLS private key cached in operator-readable GCS under non-image-bound CMEK; enables MITM.
Unattested control plane can inject a content webhook endpoint receiving prompt and completion.
